Responsibilities- You will create DFT specifications, create verification plans, and define the SoC test interface.- You will develop and implement the DFT architecture and own its integration into large SoC blocks — including IP integration, system and control bus connectivity, and the integration of memories and hard macros.- You will implement testbenches, generate directed and constrained-random tests, debug failures, run gate-level simulations, and close coverage.- You will also generate structural test vectors, run synthesis and timing closure and work closely with Chip waveform debugging tools.- Experience developing DFT specifications and driving DFT architecture and methods for designs.- Proven understanding of design verification (DV) methodologies for validating DFT implementation in simulation pre-silicon.- Proficient in a scripting language such as Python, TCL, or Perl, including familiarity or proficiency in leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate scripting and engineering workflows.- Ability to fluently speak and write in English, including expressing complex technical concepts clearly.Preferred Qualifications- Experience developing DFT specifications and driving DFT architecture and methods for designs- Proven Understanding of design verification (DV) methodologies for validating DFT implementation in simulation pre-silicon- Experience debugging compressed ATPG patterns, MBIST, and JTAG/1500 related issues.- Experience with STA constraints development and analysis for DFT modes, as well as SDF simulations.- Ability to conduct experiments during silicon debug, gathering and analyzing data, and using scripting to support efficient handling of ATE data.- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.- Experience in large SoC design or verification.

Join us!To Do- Schleifen & Polieren von Sichtkanten mit Handbearbeitungsmaschinen- Spachteln von Sichtkanten & Oberflächen-Kleben zusammengesetzter Werkstücke, z.B. für Kaminabdeckungen- Kleben von Becken und ArmierungenWanted- Erfahrung mit Natursteinarbeiten: Kleben, Schleifen, Spachteln, Kantenbearbeitung- handwerkliches Geschick- Neugier auf moderne Maschinen- verantwortungsbewusster und organisierter Arbeitsstil- einen Gesellenbrief setzen wir nicht zwingend voraus- verhandlungssichere Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch ODER Englisch ODER TürkischGerne auch- Naturwerksteinmechaniker- Quereinsteiger mit Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung von Naturstein- Quereinsteiger aus verwandten Berufen- Bewerbungen zum Beispiel aus der Türkei, Polen oder Albanien********You will find the largest marble stock in Berlin at STEINZEIT. For 30 years we produce exclusive products for the upscale interior design. Our natural stones such as marble, onyx, or granite are used as tables, restaurant, store or hotel equipment, fireplace claddings, kitchen countertops, washstands, stairs, counters and much more.What we have to offer- a bright, warm and dry working environment in single-shift operation- a small, international team with flat hierarchies- an open working atmosphere with nice colleagues (say the colleagues)- a permanent employment contract in a growing company- the opportunity to help shape a future-oriented company- a modern & versatile machine park with the latest operating technology (CNCmachining center, CNC bridge saws, water jet cutting)- further training and promotion opportunities- an attractive company location at the Neuköllner Schifffahrtskanal- queer? join us!To Do- honing & polishing of edges with hand finishing machines- filling of visible edges & surface bonding of assembled workpieces, e.g. forfireplace covers- glueing of basins and reinforcementsWanted- experience with natural stone work: glueing, grinding, levelling, edge processing- manual dexterity- curiosity about modern machines- responsible and organised working style- we do not necessarily require a journeyman's certificateGladly also- natural stone mechanics- career starters and career changers with experience in the processing of natural stone or from simlilar professions- applications for example from Turkey, Poland or Albania********İş TanımıSTEINZEIT, Berlin'deki en büyük mermer stokunu elinde bulunduran bir üretim firmasıdır. 30 yılı aşkın süredir lüks projelere özel ürünler üretiyoruz. Mermer, oniks ve granit gibi doğal taşlar ile restoran, mağaza ve oteller için masa ve çeşitli mobilyalar, şömine kaplamaları, mutfak tezgahları, lavabolar, merdivenler ve başka bir çok ürünün üretimini gerçekleştiriyoruz.Üretim hattımızda mermer ustası olarak tam zamanlı çalışmak üzere yeni iş arkadaşları arıyoruz.Sunduklarımız- Tek vardiyalı çalışma düzeni- Aydınlık, sıcak ve kuru bir çalışma ortamı- Düz hiyerarşiye sahip küçük, uluslararası bir ekip- Büyüyen bir şirkette kalıcı bir iş sözleşmesi- Gelecek odaklı bir şirketi şekillendirmeye yardımcı olma fırsatı- İleri eğitim ve terfi fırsatları- Son teknoloji, modern ve çok yönlü makineler (CNC işleme merkezi, CNC köprü kesim, su jeti, otomatik kenar cila makines- Berlin- Neukölln şehir merkezinde cazip şirket konumuGörevler- Avuç taşlama makinesi ile kenar taşlama ve parlatma- Gerekli durumlarda kenar ve yüzeylerde dolgu işleminin uygulanması- Açılı kesilen parçaların yapıştırılması- Evyelerin yapıştırılmasıAranan Özellikler- Yapıştırma, taşlama, cilalama, kenar işleme gibi doğal taş işleme deneyimi- El becerisi- Modern mermer işleme makinelerine merak- Sorumlu, düzenli ve saygılı çalışma tarzı- Ekip çalışmasına yatkınlık- Tercihen orta seviye Almanca veya İngilizce- Kalfalık veya ustalık belgesi zorunluluğu yoktur.Ayrıca fayans, seramik, restorasyon gibi ilgili sektörlerde deneyimli ve kariyer değiştirmek isteyen adayların da başvurularını bekliyoruz.Lütfen CV’niz ile birlikte online başvuruda bulunun.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Natursteinbearbeitung

jobs.occupation: Research Engineer Future Building Technology (f/m/div.) / REF284442E (Resident Engineer)
jobs.description: Willkommen bei BoschBei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf eine Bewerbung!Job Description- As a building technology research engineer at Bosch Corporate Research you will work on the transition towards a sustainable energy and heat supply for the future.- You will use and improve a modern simulation and optimization tool chain to evaluate energy and heat supply solutions in terms of sustainability and cost.- With your concepts, model-based analyses, and research results, you will promote the market success of sustainable heating technologies such as heat pumps.- You will research innovative solutions for future Bosch building technologies and heating system products and demonstrate these as prototypes in our laboratories.- Furthermore, you will independently work on research tasks in the field of heat pump and control technology, develop your own concepts as well as ideas, in addition to supervising students or PhD candidates.- Last but not least, you will actively network within the scientific community and cooperate closely with leading research institutes and universities.Qualifications- Education: excellent university degree Master or PhD in Engineering or Natural Sciences (e.g., Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Energy Technology, Electrical Engineering, Technical Cybernetics, Physics) or comparable field- Experience and Knowledge: excellent know-how in the simulation and optimization of energy systems; experience in building technology, AI, and control engineering is an advantage; work experience in the context of energy systems is desirable- Personality and Working Practice: you have a high intrinsic motivation for thermodynamics and sustainable energy supply, quickly grasp complex issues and communicate them clearly, working on solutions in a self-reliant as well as team-oriented, structured, and creative manner- Languages: fluent in English written and spokenAdditional Informationhttps://www.bosch-ai.comwww.bosch.com/researchPlease submit all relevant documents (CV, certificates, and links to GitHub or kaggle account).We offer flexible working models: from various part-time options to mobile working and job sharing. Feel free to contact us.Diversity and inclusion are not just trends for us but are firmly anchored in our corporate culture. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regardless of gender, age, disability, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity.Work #LikeABosch starts here: Apply now!

KLIFOVET GmbH, part of the Argenta Group, is a globally recognized supplier in the veterinary and feed sector based in Munich. We have made it our mission to competently accompany customers from the idea, through development, to approval and beyond. The service for our customers determines our actions. Since our founding in 1997, we have been awarded three times as the best service provider and the best contract research organization internationally.About the roleThe commercial project assistant role is a great opportunity to gain development within a dynamic and diverse team. Some of the key tasks you will be involved with are:- Supporting project managers in the preparation and execution of clinical trials- Procurement of study materials and office supplies- Support of the departments in the area of shipping and logistics- Support for data maintenance and data collection- Documentation and archiving of study documents- Labelling, dispensing, and administration of study medication- First point of contact for customers and service providers on site and by telephone- General office activities and support of in-house administrative processesAbout youBy nature, you are a positive team player, embracing change and flexibility ensuring you are agile to meet the business demands.  You are reliable, and ambitious to learn new skills achieving the best you can in support of your team.Experience and key skills- A completed commercial apprenticeship or an apprenticeship in the pharmaceutical/medical field- Solid knowledge in the use of MS Office programs- Interest and curiosity to familiarize yourself with new tasks and areas of knowledge- Independent, reliable and bring structure to your tasks- Excellent German and English language skills, both written and verbal,  other foreign language skills are an advantage- Customer-oriented, confident and positive appearance as well as open to having fun working in a teamWe offer you a detailed introduction to your field of work, an independent, challenging and varied job, modern work equipment, family-friendly working hours, regular training and further education and a positive and collegial team in an appealing ambience in Munich.If this sounds like an interesting role to you and you are looking for a new opportunity we would love to hear from you.  Please apply for this role via www.argentaglobal.com/careers
